summary: Modiv Industrial, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing quarterly dividends on its Series A Preferred Stock ($0.4609375/share, payable July 15, 2026) and monthly distributions on its Common Stock ($0.10/share for July and August 2026, payable August 10 and August 31, 2026 respectively). This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No terms, premium, or special structure are provided. What to watch: none; this is a standard capital return event.
